public_rationale: OpenAI confirmed a confidential IPO filing in June 2026. That is substantial evidence for the narrower prediction that it would prepare a route to public markets. It does not establish a completed listing or prove that listing is necessary. The Microsoft partnership also supplies a strategic rationale that complicates the claim's absolute wording. With no deadline and no decisive event settling the full proposition, the claim remains unresolved.
limitations: A procedural reading of 'work out a way' would yield a more favorable assessment.
Strategic benefits are not the same as demonstrated durable investment returns.
Listing timing is supported by news reporting because the underlying interview was not retrieved.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: At some point OpenAI will have to work out a way to go public, because otherwise there is absolutely no reason to invest unless you expect to sell your shares in a future secondary sale.
conditions: unless investing to offload shares in a future secondary sale

statement.excerpt: Also, at some point, OpenAI will have to work out a way to go public, because otherwise there is absolutely no reason to invest in this company, unless you are doing so with the belief that you will be able to offload your shares in a future secondary sale.

from_speaker: will have to work out a way to go public
offload your shares in a future secondary sale
our_interpretation: I distinguish preparing an IPO from completing a public listing.
The secondary-sale clause is an exception to the claimed investment rationale, not a separately observable trigger that must occur before assessment.
The full proposition includes both a future listing requirement and the assertion that other investment rationales are unavailable. A filing alone cannot establish both.
criteria.support_condition: A completed public listing would establish the listing outcome. Supporting the full necessity claim would additionally require evidence that investors outside the secondary-sale exception depended on that route for returns.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Documented durable investor returns through another route, without dependence on a future listing or secondary sale, would contradict the asserted necessity.
